name: ManageEngine Endpoint Central Dctask64.EXE Potential Abuse
description:
Detects the execution of "dctask64.exe", a signed binary by ZOHO Corporation part of ManageEngine Endpoint Central.
This binary can be abused for DLL injection, arbitrary command and process execution.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\dctask64.exe OR (winlog.event_data.Hashes:(*IMPHASH\=6834B1B94E49701D77CCB3C0895E1AFD* OR *IMPHASH\=1BB6F93B129F398C7C4A76BB97450BBA* OR *IMPHASH\=FAA2AC19875FADE461C8D89DCF2710A3* OR *IMPHASH\=F1039CED4B91572AB7847D26032E6BBF*))) AND (process.command_line:(*\ executecmd64\ * OR *\ invokeexe\ * OR *\ injectDll\ *))
